cohort: The study included 482 women without pre-pregnancy diabetes.
finding: Visceral adipose tissue (VAT) depth in early pregnancy significantly differed by maternal ethnicity, with Latin American, Sub-Saharan African, and Caribbean women exhibiting higher VAT depth compared to Canadian-born women, and these groups also experienced a greater percentage of preterm births.
mod_finding: Women from Latin American, Sub-Saharan African, and Caribbean regions had a greater percentage of emergency CSs compared to Canadian-born women.
